name: arc-hollow-frame-parity-fill
description: Use when an ARC grid contains multiple hollow, one-cell-thick square frames; fill each frame interior by parity.
---

# ARC hollow-frame parity fill

## Trigger
Use when a grid contains multiple hollow square outlines of different colors and sizes on a uniform background, and demonstrations show their interiors being filled while borders/background remain unchanged.

## Rule
Preserve all original cells except the empty cells enclosed by each frame. Fill each frame's interior uniformly:
- Interior side length odd → color 7.
- Interior side length even → color 2.

Because these are one-cell-thick square frames, outer side length and interior side length have the same parity. Thus the fill is 7 for odd-sized frames and 2 for even-sized frames. Frame color and background color do not determine the fill.

## Procedure
1. Identify each closed, one-cell-thick square outline and its bounding rows/columns.
2. Confirm the border is one cell thick and compute interior dimensions (bounding-box width/height minus 2).
3. For each frame, replace only its enclosed interior cells with 7 if the interior side is odd, otherwise 2.
4. Leave all frame borders, unrelated objects, and background cells unchanged.
5. Validate the output dimensions and confirm no cells outside frame interiors changed.

## Demonstration evidence
Observed across two examples with varying frame colors and dimensions: 1x1 and 3x3 interiors were filled with 7; 4x4 and 6x6 interiors were filled with 2. This supports the parity rule rather than a rule based on outline color.
